answer: Mechanism: Convex Footprint Pricing. Each agent pays c·e^{α·ρ}, where ρ measures overlap of its resource fingerprint (ASN, hardware class, storage locality) with existing call clusters; no admission gate. Honest agents wander across providers, keeping ρ low on a velvet terrace of cheap fees. Sybils correlate, so each added identity raises ρ and pays exponentially more. Attack cost: provisioning independent ASNs, hosts, and storage plus the surcharge—not a flat registration fee.
